versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the redesigned skill for Deckly deck beautification.
- Enables interactive, step-by-step workflow to analyze, style, preview, fine-tune, and render polished PowerPoint or PDF slides using Deckly's AI.
- New chat-based onboarding process for Deckly account creation, verification, and login — no website needed.
- Clearly describes free preview and credit pricing model for users before any paid action.
- Supports one-shot and interactive redesigns, with detailed commands and fallback HTTP option.
